description: This file defines a Java interface 'TemplateRepository' that extends JpaRepository for managing 'Template' entities. It includes method signatures for custom queries related to fetching 'Template' objects based on entity, type, and mapper key-value pairs.

classes.name: TemplateRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for Template entity, providing basic CRUD operations and custom query methods.

methods.name: findByEntityAndType
methods.description: Finds templates matching a specific entity and template type.

methods.name: findByTemplateMapper
methods.description: Finds templates associated with given mapper key and value.
